messages:
alex: Heads-up: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123 is blocking the hotfix deploy. Need 2x LGTM by 11:30am PT cutoff for today's rollout. @maria @chris can you take a look? CI is currently flaky on one test.
maria: Looking now, will review in ~15m.
dev-bot: CI pipeline #5123 — failed: unit-tests (redis-cache-spec) (rerun: /pipelines/9999)
sam: If we miss cutoff we push to the 6pm window; try to keep this tiny. Also please add a small changelog snippet in the PR.
priya: I see the failing test — intermittent timeout in cache expiry test. Quick fix: increase sleep to 120ms or mock time. I'll open a patch shortly.
chris: In a meeting until 11:00, but if priya's patch is tiny I'll lgtm after tests pass. +assign to me for final check.
maria: Reviewed, left one minor comment about error handling (nit). Approving once tests are green.
priya: Pushed fix: changed test to mock time. Rerunning CI.
dev-bot: CI pipeline #5123 — succeeded: unit-tests, integration, lint
maria: LGTM
chris: LGTM — merging now 🚀
alex: Thanks everyone — pushing to prod once release job finishes. Noted for retrospective: flaky cache test ticket.
